payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses prefix difference between global most frequent element and another value, stores first occurrence in an array to find longest subarray with equal counts, effectively a map pattern.
payload.rationale: Solution computes prefix sums of (count must_apper - count j) and finds longest subarray where they tie by tracking first index of each difference; this is a classic prefix-sum-with-hash-map technique, not greedy.
